title: Returning a special-order part to inventory adds its number to the Part Library
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop; locations Staging Heavy Duty and Staging Lethbridge). Current location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin (or a default Parts Manager): Part Library & Inventory View, Create & Edit and Delete, and See Financial Data. Data: an open work order at Staging Heavy Duty; a vendor; the new number QAPL-SO-R1, which is not in the Part Library or Inventory (search both first).
custom_steps:
1. On the work order: Add Part > type " QAPL-SO-R1 " (one space before and after) > add it as a special order with the vendor, a cost and qty 1 > save.
  2. Order and receive that part request in full (through its purchase order).
  3. Parts > Part Library > search "QAPL-SO-R1"; then Parts > Inventory > search "QAPL-SO-R1".
  4. On the work order, return the received special-order part to inventory, into a bin at Staging Heavy Duty.
  5. Parts > Inventory > search "QAPL-SO-R1".
  6. Parts > Part Library > search "QAPL-SO-R1" > open the entry.
custom_expected:
1. The work order shows the special-order part request for QAPL-SO-R1.
  2. The part is received onto the work order.
  3. Part Library: exactly one entry "QAPL-SO-R1", with no spaces before or after. Inventory: no QAPL-SO-R1 part yet.
  4. The return to inventory is accepted.
  5. A QAPL-SO-R1 part is listed at Staging Heavy Duty with the returned quantity.
  6. Still exactly one entry "QAPL-SO-R1" (no second entry, no outer spaces); its parts table lists the new inventory part at Staging Heavy Duty.
